Why Water Monitoring

The problem

Tanks overflow and waste water, or run dry without warning — and checking levels means climbing onto the roof or opening an underground sump.

Our solution

A level sensor on the tank reports the water level continuously. The phone app shows it live as it rises and falls, and a Telegram message warns you the moment the tank drops below 15% or goes above 95%.

// 02

Key features

  1. 01

    Live level on your phone

    The percentage on the app rises and falls in real time, exactly as the water in the tank does.

  2. 02

    Tank-empty alert

    When the level drops below 15%, a Telegram message tells you the tank is nearly empty.

  3. 03

    Overflow alert

    When the level goes above 95%, a Telegram message warns you before the tank overflows.

  4. 04

    Filling or in use

    See at a glance whether the tank is filling up or being used.

  5. 05

    Overhead & sump tanks

    Works with rooftop and underground tanks.

// 03

How it works

  1. Step 1

    A level sensor is mounted on the tank lid and measures the water level continuously.

  2. Step 2

    The level is sent to the phone app, where it updates live as the tank fills and empties.

  3. Step 3

    Below 15%, a Telegram message says the tank is empty — time to refill.

  4. Step 4

    Above 95%, a Telegram message warns of overflow — time to stop the water.

// 04

// 05

Under the hood

Technical overview

A level sensor on the tank lid reads the water level continuously and sends it to the app. Alerts are delivered as Telegram messages at two thresholds: below 15% (tank empty) and above 95% (overflow). Contact us for sensor options and installation details for your tanks.

// 06

FAQ

How quickly does the app update?

Continuously — the level on your phone rises and falls along with the water in the tank.

When do I get alerts?

You get a Telegram message when the level drops below 15% (tank empty) and when it goes above 95% (overflow).

Do I need Telegram?

Yes — alerts are sent as Telegram messages, so install Telegram on the phone that should receive them.
